material_loss: exact R=1 volume-weighted componentwise relative-permittivity L1, s_ref=1
reference_target: continuous coefficient prior, tensor Chebyshev approximation to full-Mie n14; finite conditional sample utility
case_selection: all existing development cases in original order; exposed

calibration.response: gain only, material-independent unit known reference
calibration.feasibility: analytic simulation design, no actual hardware observation

measurement_cost: one normalized acquisition block at common dwell; parallel channel readout assumed; no seconds/energy claim
probability_scope: reference-based uses original continuous prior and proper shared truncated gain; candidate-only has no probabilities
retrospective_old_channels: not counted as new evidence; retrospective removal experiment NOT_RUN
raw_candidate_set: per-case package full64 predictions; 37 paid representatives over all cases
Fisher: derivatives of saved continuous response at online candidates, parameter-width scaled, never truth-state
truth_usage: offline realized MAE only; selection module takes no truth
